title: Workflows Use Pack Dsl Documents and Protocol Op Commands
description:
Workflows (OsWorkflow inside OsProjection, the workflow planner fixtures, and the workflow UI transport) are still represented in JSON in several places, violating the repo's constitutional representations: documents must have a dsl (text) + pack (binary) face via store::DocumentDsl/store::DocumentPack, commands must have an op (text) + protocol (binary) face via OpText/OpBinary.

Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/workflows-are-still-wrongly-purrfect-minsky.md (approved). Scope:
- W1: promote WorkflowFixture to a real dsl::DslDocument; replace the five JSON planner fixtures (chain/dead-end/diamond/no-dirty/single-edge) with handcrafted .dsl + checked-in .spk pairs; add dsl<->pack equivalence + canonical-fixpoint tests.
- W2: TS twin (framework/product/os/core/js) decodes fixtures via a wasm export instead of JSON.parse; fix stale TS mirror types (resourceKind->artifactKind, missing contract field).
- W3: space.os.json persistence -> space.os.pack/.spr; OsBackbonePort goes byte-based instead of string-only.
- W4: os_workflow_to_flow_fixture / apply_flow_fixture_to_os_workflow become typed over FlowFixture instead of hand-built serde_json::Value.
- W5: NodeGraphScene's eight *_json string fields become typed records (ui/wgpu); compile-driven ripple across ~9 plugin UIs + 2 renderers + framework/surface/node-graph + framework/core/js + React.
- W6: full cutover of the shared fixture_json/setFixture channel to fixture_dsl across flow, space/OS, dag, sequence, trinity/jack, trinity/rewrite legs (including fixing three consumers whose setFixture handler is currently silently broken due to a type mismatch).
- W7: confirm OsOperation op/protocol coverage; move nodeGraphViewport/nodeGraphHover actions off embedded JSON strings.
- W8: MediaPayload::Structured{json} -> MediaPayload::Structured{pack bytes}.

This is a large multi-file Rust+TS change across framework/product/os, s/kernel/flow, s/plugin/space, s/plugin/dag, s/plugin/sequence, s/plugin/trinity, ui/wgpu, framework/surface/node-graph, framework/renderer/react, framework/renderer/wgpu, framework/core. See the plan file for exact file:line references and sequencing (W1 -> W2/W3/W4 in parallel -> W5 -> W6 -> W7/W8).
